source_text: Eligite hodie — nos et domus nostra Domino serviemus. Viginti sex homiliae in Iesum Nave completae Rufino interprete. Gloria Patri et Filio et Spiritui Sancto in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Choose today — we and house our to-Lord we-will-serve. Twenty six homilies unto Jesus Nun completed with-Rufinus translator. Glory to-Father and Son and Spirit Holy into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Choose this day — we and our house will serve the Lord >> Bible:Joshua 24:15]]. Twenty-six homilies on Jesus son of Nun are complete in Rufinus’s Latin. Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit forever. Amen.
